messages:
elaine: kicking off Q3 planning thread for Console observability — specifically retention, dashboard UX for long-tail traces, and error-analysis workflows. want to align on scope + launch criteria

mason: +1. customers keep asking for longer retention windows and better trace navigation across 90d+

devin: we got requests from two customers this week (FinCorp, EduLabs) asking for 90d traces for audit + compliance. they expect query speed ~interactive.

priya: rough tradeoff: 90d raw traces expensive. propose tiered retention and hot/warm buckets. access patterns: 0-7d hot, 8-30d warm (sampled), 31-90d archived (index-only).

sarah: can we show customers the cost impact in-console before they change retention? need a cost estimator in UI.

alex: agree on estimator. implementation note: we can reuse existing metrics pipeline to produce per-customer cost projection. needs schema change for per-route token counts.

kevin: launch criteria proposal (must have all):
- retention tiers UI (7/30/90)
- cost estimator in settings
- query performance SLO: 95p < 1.5s for hot, <5s for warm sampled
- migration doc + a one-click archive plan
- regression tests for dashboard load under 500 concurrent users

mason: +1 to criteria. small ask: add a feature flag/preview toggle so we can roll out to Dedicated customers first.

elaine: good call. feature flag required. product asks: can we commit to GA in Q3 or is this Q4?

priya: engineering estimate: baseline feature can be Preview in Q3 (8 weeks). GA with full archive/restore and indexing for 90d likely Q4 (additional 6 weeks).

devin: customer-driven asks prioritized:
1) per-query CSV export for audits
2) retention SLA for Dedicated
3) webhook alerting on trace regressions
We should map these to OKRs.

kevin: map to OKRs suggestion:
- O: Make observability fit for regulated customers
  - KR1: retention tiers shipped to preview by EoQ (rollout to 20% of large customers)
  - KR2: Console cost estimator implemented and within 10% accuracy vs bill
  - KR3: reduce time-to-find-error for 90d traces by 30% (measured on sample queries)

alex: implementing sampled warm storage means we need a sampling policy UI too. that's another small scope item.

mason: important to surface the sampling rate in the UI and in exports, else compliance teams will complain.

priya: ok add sampling transparency to MVP. note: sampling config options: deterministic (by trace-id hash), percentage, or policy-based (error-priority).

elaine: customer comms: we'll offer migration assistance + a migration runbook. @devin can you draft a short FAQ for sales?

devin: on it. will draft by EOD Friday. includes: why sampling, cost tradeoffs, SLA differences between tiers.

kevin: tech blockers: indexing 90d with query latency target — need a proof-of-concept on warm index layout. propose spike this sprint (2w).

alex: agree. will schedule the spike and attach perf benchmarks.

release-bot: scheduled: feature-flag infra deployment at 2026-07-12T15:00Z (info only) :rocket:

mason: rollout plan sketch: 1) internal alpha w/ eng team 2) Dedicated customers opt-in 3) limited hosted preview 20% 4) GA with opt-out migration tool.

elaine: decisions log so far: preview in Q3, GA Q4, feature-flag required, cost estimator required, sampling transparency in MVP, spike for warm index this sprint. i'll capture these in the roadmap doc.

priya: anything else missing? RUM traces? soa logs merging?

mason: let's keep RUM integration for a follow-up; it's a big scope. merging logs should be an opt-in pipeline in Q4.

elaine: perfect. thanks all — I'll update the product roadmap and link the PRD. follow-up meeting Fri 10am to lock OKRs. :white_check_mark:
